approved_decisions.decision: PostgreSQL enforces at most one active primary operator per company with the partial unique index delivered in V0019.
PostgreSQL company_grant is authoritative; portfolio access is revalidated company by company and cache enumeration is forbidden.
Use ADR-024 hybrid lineage: shared column plans, exact row locators and append-only row overrides.
A Platform human approves engine releases after independent Security and QA review and complete reproducibility evidence; API and workers cannot approve.
Operational or financial sensitivity and personal-data category are separate mandatory classification axes. Legal applicability remains required before DRG-00.
Interactive sessions are short-lived and revalidated online; durable jobs, exports, links and capabilities use a persistent issued authorization context.
Missing contractual test identifiers are drift; planned runtime identifiers remain a separately classified backlog.
Structured JSON is authoritative and Markdown is the human-readable projection.
QA reconciles the catalog on contract changes and before releases; Integration Steward reviews the reconciliation.
Keep the deterministic mutation harness in CI with human adjudication of survivors and no automatic equivalence.

adr_decisions.ADR-002: Select the Fincilia SQL-first migrator with checksums, concurrency control, replay tests and PostgreSQL 17 support; do not adopt Flyway now.
adr_decisions.ADR-008: Start without Temporal; use PostgreSQL dispatch pointers, leases and workers and reconsider only on a measured scale or operating-cost trigger.
adr_decisions.ADR-024: Accept the hybrid logical and physical lineage representation.
